title: The Way of All Flesh by Samuel Bulter The Easton Press Collector’s Edition
descriptionText:
This is a rare and highly sought-after Collector's Edition of "The Way of All Flesh" by Samuel Butler. This hardcover book is a must-have for any serious collector of classic literature and world literature. The book is written in English and is part of the Historical book series. 

The book's topic is Classicism and is categorized under Books & Magazines and Books. It is an antique and collectible item that will make a great addition to any book lover's collection. The Easton Press has done an excellent job of crafting this Collector's Edition, making it a true masterpiece. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare book.
